out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The water temperature at the handwashing sink next to the 2 large rice cookers is very slow to heat up. A device on the hot water line has to be turned on before water temperature will get to at least 100°F. EHS did not observe water at handsink next to the cookline of at least 100°F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: sushi rice
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EMPLOYEE LABELED SUSHI RICE WITH TIME.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticide labeled for residential use were observed in the facility. A can of RAID was observed on an ingredient storage shelf next to the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. DISCARDED.

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connection under the handsink next to the 2 large rice cookers is leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: EHS observed employee wash hands with gloves on.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. PIC stopped employee had them remove gloves and wash hands,

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: EHS observed handwashing sinks in the kitchen area not being able to meet 100F minimum.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC agreed to have hand-sinks repaired, EHS will follow up in 10 days to verify compliance.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: EHS observed raw beef being stored above raw fish in the 2 door upright storage fridge
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC removed beef so it was below raw fish. SAMURAI JAPANESE STEAKHOUSE (Inspection Date: 03/04/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Rice (57F, 60 F), cooked noodles (53F, 64F) for longer than 4 hours
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC disposed of rice and cooked noodles.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employee medicine is being stored above a food contact surface in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC removed medicine from above food contact surface.

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC disposed of pesticide.

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: EHS observed Chlorine based sanitizer being measured at 500+ppm.
violations.corrective_action: PIC diluted sanitizer so it was measured at 200ppm using a test kit.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: EHS observed rice scoops buried in the rice so the handles could not be reached without touching the rice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed scoops from rice and had them washed rinsed and sanitized.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Single-service items were observed reused for the storage of low sodium soy sauce.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items may not be reused. PIC agreed to replace soy sauce dispenser from single use bottle to NSF approved multi use container.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of garlic powder were observed reused for the storage of dry spices.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC agreed to replace the dry spices containers.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC agreed to have walk in cooler expired by next inspection.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: rice cookers
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC agreed to clean rice cookers by next inspection.
